<function name="SetDuckSpeed" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets how quickly a player ducks.

<bug issue="2722">This will not work for values &gt;= 1.</bug>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="duckSpeed" type="number">How quickly the player will duck.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
